storage_lead: Where JGates keeps runs, drafts and plans on your computer, how much space each workspace uses and what retention deletes.
storage_relink_lead: The project is no longer at {path}. Enter the new folder: the history of this workspace will appear in the workspace of that folder. Nothing is copied or moved.
storage_relinked: History of {name} relinked to the new path.
storage_delete_preview: {runs, plural, one {# run will be deleted} other {# runs will be deleted}}, {size} in total.
storage_delete_marked: {count} of these runs are marked as baseline or preserved and will also be deleted.
storage_delete_scope: Only the folders below, inside the JGates data folder, are deleted:
storage_delete_project_safe: The project (which was at {path}) is not touched.
storage_retention_next_value: {runs, plural, one {# run would be deleted} other {# runs would be deleted}} ({size}).
storage_retention_protected: Runs marked as baseline or preserved, and runs still being written, never enter the cleanup.
storage_retention_cli: shows the full list; jgates gc --yes deletes.
storage_images_unavailable: The container engine did not answer, so the space of the images could not be read.
storage_images_none: No JGates image on this computer.
storage_engine_off: The container engine did not answer, so the space of the tools, caches and projects could not be read.
storage_shared_note: Sizes count only the layers that are not shared; shared layers are counted once.
storage_clean_unused: Clean what is not in use
storage_cleanup_title_all: Clean what is not in use
storage_cleanup_engine_off: The container engine did not answer: only the files in the data folder are listed.
storage_cleanup_summary: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} will be removed, {size} in total. Check the list before confirming.
storage_cleanup_skipped: Kept because they are in use
storage_cleanup_done: {count, plural, one {# item removed} other {# items removed}}, {size} freed.
storage_cleanup_left: {count, plural, one {# item stayed} other {# items stayed}} because it was in use or could not be removed.
storage_uninstall_home: The data folder {path} ({size}) is removed too, once everything above is gone.
storage_uninstall_keep_notes: Keep my preferences and the list of workspaces
storage_uninstall_keys: Also remove the saved API keys
storage_uninstall_cli_note: The jgates program itself and the files inside your projects are not touched.
